svg.aria-label: Tooltip dimensional drawing: arrowless popup, intrinsic width, wrapping, padding, shadow, placement, cursor anchoring and exploded glass layers

g.text: H1 = 2·S2 + N·L1 · SINGLE TEXT LINE: 24 NOMINAL
B = 0 · THE EDGE RING IS SHADOW, NOT A LAYOUT BORDER.

svg.text: SCALE 1:1 IN HEIGHT · WIDTHS ARE HUG
GLASS AND RING SHARE ONE BOX; LAYERS SEPARATED FOR STUDY.
NO SCRIM AND NO ARROW PART ARE RENDERED.
CONTENT WIDTH IS INTRINSIC, CAPPED BY MW.
N TEXT LINES GROW HEIGHT; CUSTOM CHILDREN MAY GROW IT.
DEFAULT TOP / CENTER, S3 FROM THE ANCHOR.
COLLISIONS CAN CHANGE THE RESOLVED SIDE / ALIGNMENT.
NO ARROW IS IN THE COMPOSED ANATOMY.
CURSOR TRACKING MOVES THE ANCHOR, NOT A POINTER TIP.
LONG WORDS WRAP ANYWHERE; TEXT WRAP IS PRETTY.
NO FIXED HEIGHT OR MAX-HEIGHT IS SET BY THE WRAPPER.
GROUP TRIGGERS SHARE ONE POPUP AND PAYLOAD.
SIZE / POSITION CHANGE IMMEDIATELY ON HANDOFF.
KEYBOARD FOCUS ANCHORS TO THE TRIGGER.
TRIGGER GEOMETRY AND TOUCH TARGET ARE CALLER-OWNED.
SCALE 2:1 IN HEIGHT · NOMINAL LIGHT-THEME EXTENTS
ENVELOPE USES BL + SP ± Y; SOFT SHADOW HAS NO HARD EDGE.
SCHEMATIC · FOUR PREFERRED SIDES · DEFAULT TRACKING NONE
R2 = R1 + Q · OUTER SHADOW RING, NOT A BORDER
UNEQUAL S1 / S2 → NO CONCENTRIC CONTENT WELL.
INSTANT HANDOFF / CURSOR TRACKING: NO TRANSITION.
LOCAL POSITIONER DEFAULTS · LIVE OPEN / FONT-READY MEASUREMENTS
